prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Edit target: the supplied outdoor-road concept board. Keep EXACTLY its board composition, room geometry, room positions, all walls, every indoor floor, furniture, grass, court and camera. Redesign the outdoor circulation surface only, plus matching three detail panels and title. The previous version is unattractive because it is brown-beige, dirty, noisy, full of little patch repairs and looks like a courtyard tiled with giant squares. Correct this decisively.

New art direction: a restrained, polished game-art INDUSTRIAL CONCRETE WALKWAY, matte neutral slate grey slightly cool (#7f8585 approximate), lighter than asphalt, medium value distinctly darker than the light indoor green-grey floors. Broad continuous ribbon of smooth brushed poured concrete. Very low contrast fine surface texture, clear softly shaded silhouettes, cohesive with existing hand-painted game art. It must read as a PATH between buildings, not ceramic tiles or random flagstones.
Joints: remove the full square paving grid on roads. Just occasional thin quiet transverse concrete expansion seams, spaced farther apart than the whole corridor width. Intersections are continuous unbroken concrete. Remove ALL dark square patches and branching cracks in the main map. Only tiny subdued edge wear, slight grey dust near wall bases. No scattered gravel noise.
Edges: one consistent NARROW flat light grey concrete edge strip around grass interfaces and outside wall bases, about 4% of corridor width at most. A very subtle dark contact seam adds clarity. Flat threshold across each doorway with indoor material immediately readable behind it. No raised curb across doors, no additional fencing, no obstruction. Remove 70% of previous drainage grates; keep only a few small quiet dark recessed grates at junction edges, never giant wall stripes. No car lane markings.
Visual balance: roads are calm negative space around richer orange wood furnishings and blue steel equipment. Light cream wall copings stay brighter than roads. Grass stays green and does not spread into the path. The design should look deliberately art-directed, clean but lived-in, not glossy, sterile or modern luxury architecture.
Bottom three detail panels: same scene positions and size as previous board, now showing (1) clean matte grey concrete, one very thin expansion seam, fine restrained brushed grain; (2) the same grey road with narrow light grey edging meeting existing grass, one SMALL recessed grate; (3) a smooth FLAT medical/industrial room entrance transitioning from grey road to pale small indoor tiles. Only mild wear, no cracks or contrasting repair squares.
Change title verbatim to "园区室外道路 · 灰色混凝土". Captions remain exactly "路面质感", "路沿与排水", "室内外过渡". No extra text.
Avoid brown, beige or sandy roads, cobblestones, square pavement grid, noisy grunge, dramatic cracks, patches, black asphalt, highway markings, bright yellow outlines, new props or characters, scene changes, perspective changes, editor UI.
Make a noticeable aesthetic improvement over the old draft.
